name: CX Power Limited
ownership_summary: Described by NDA/SOSE as 'an entity comprising GA Consultants and Global Mutual Properties Limited'. CX Power Limited incorporated 28 November 2025 (nine days after the strategic-developer announcement), registered at Ort House, 147 Arlington Road, Camden, London NW1 7ET; SIC 68209 (letting/operating of own or leased real estate). Directors: Giovanni Maria Ciuccio, Graham Henry Edwards.
notes: PSC register entries not visible at retrieval (2026-07-30). It is inferred but not confirmed that CX Power Limited 16880627 is the 'CX Power' named in the NDA announcement (the announcement pre-dates incorporation).

name: GA Consultants
ownership_summary: Named as one of the two constituents of CX Power; SOSE gives CX Power's contact as enquiries@gaconsultants.co.uk. Corporate identity/company number not established.

name: Global Mutual Properties Limited
ownership_summary: Named as the other constituent of CX Power; part of the Global Mutual real-estate investment group. Specific company number not verified.

name: Nuclear Decommissioning Authority
notes: Owns the Chapelcross estate including the 135 acres of unlicensed land; entered Heads of Terms with CX Power in November 2025.

name: Nuclear Restoration Services
notes: NDA group subsidiary operating/decommissioning the licensed Chapelcross site; partner in the wider hub programme and convenor of the Site Stakeholder Group.

name: South of Scotland Enterprise
notes: Economic development agency; partner in the Chapelcross masterplan and manager of the adjacent (separate) Chapelcross Energy Transition Zone plots.

name: Borderlands Inclusive Growth Deal (Borderlands Partnership)
notes: Named strategic partner in the wider Chapelcross hub programme; the £350m cross-border deal funds Chapelcross site infrastructure works, but no project-specific funding for the data centre campus has been identified. The campus itself is described as privately funded.
